text: Global npm install gives a CLI that works in any directory
quote: npm i -g foreloop   # installs globally, so the CLI works in any directory

text: foreloop init installs a task-executor skill so an agent in that checkout can pick up the project's tasks
quote: foreloop init installs the task-executor skill into the checkout, which is what lets an agent working in that directory pick up the project's tasks.

text: An agent running locally asks for and claims an approved task, does the work, and opens a pull request from the user's GitHub account
quote: You run an agent — Claude Code or Codex — in a checkout of your repository on your own machine. That agent asks Foreloop for approved tasks in that repository, claims one, does the work, and opens a pull request from your GitHub account.

text: A plain-language problem description is enough to start a task without knowing which files will change
quote: "Users can't tell which invoices are overdue" is enough to start; you do not need to know which files change.

text: Foreloop exposes an MCP endpoint over streamable HTTP reachable with just a URL and API key
quote: Foreloop speaks MCP at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP. An MCP client needs that URL and an API key and nothing else

text: A feedback SDK function initializes the widget using a write-only API key and reporter identity
No agent action runs until a human approves the task's contract, since it changes the repository
quote: Nothing runs until a person approves a contract. Approval is the only gate, and the gate is deliberate: an agent is about to change your repository.

text: A live agents dashboard shows each worker's identity, checkout name, held task, and last status message
quote: Development, under Agents, lists one row per worker: which agent it is running as, the name that checkout gave itself, the task it holds, and the last thing it said.

text: Every CLI command supports a stable, additive-only --json output for scripting
quote: `--json` works on any command and has a stable shape. Additive changes only.

text: Recurring corrections given to an agent should be captured as a reusable written skill
quote: Write a skill when you notice yourself giving an agent the same correction twice.

text: Task links can be pasted into a commit message or typed into a browser address bar to open directly
quote: Paste one into a commit message or type one into the address bar after the site name to open it directly.

text: An intention can be started from a submitted report, with an agent filling in the intention and proposing tasks
quote: An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks

text: A single embed tag adds the feedback widget to any web project with no build step required
quote: One tag, and we serve the widget. Right for most web projects — Webflow, Framer, WordPress, or any hand-written HTML. Nothing to build

text: The feedback widget's launcher label and color can be customized via data attributes or config
quote: data-button-label` / `buttonLabel` and `data-button-color` / `buttonColor` — the launcher's wording and fill.

text: Connecting GitHub lets Foreloop read the repository code and lets an agent open pull requests against it
quote: Connecting GitHub is how Foreloop reads your code, and how an agent opens a pull request against it.

text: Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks can be managed from a terminal or any automated caller including coding agents and cron
quote: Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal — and from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron.

text: Key decisions can be approved remotely from a phone while agents continue working
quote: Approve the big calls from your phone.

text: Customers can point at a page element and the widget captures the page, metadata, and an optional screenshot for the agent to fix
quote: Customers point at the element. The widget adds the page, its metadata, and an optional screenshot, so the model fixes the right thing.
